transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

For the past five months, I've been dealing with really extreme mood swings that I just can't seem to control. Some days I feel incredibly high, happy, and bursting with energy, but then I'll suddenly get super irritated and angry over the smallest things. It feels like I'm constantly hyperactive and just can't calm down.

When you feel unusually high or full of energy, does it come in distinct episodes lasting several days with less need for sleep, or have you felt restless and hyperactive most of your life, even as a child?
No, I haven't felt this way my whole life or when I was a kid. This extreme energy and the intense mood swings only started about five months ago.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever had hallucinations, heard voices, or believed things that others said weren’t true? If so, did that happen only when your mood was elevated?

Yes, I've heard voices that weren't there and believed things that others told me weren't real, like thinking people were watching me or that I had special powers. However, those experiences only happened during those high-energy times when my mood was elevated, and never at any other time.
During these high-energy periods, did your symptoms ever become severe enough that you were hospitalized, unable to function, or others felt you were out of touch with reality?

Yes, during those high periods I definitely felt completely out of touch with reality, and others noticed it too because of the voices and beliefs I was experiencing. I was never hospitalized, but it made it extremely difficult for me to function normally in my daily life.
